name: damaged-fence
description: Chain link fence with a cut section; the model also cites an ID outside the candidate list.

candidateControls.title: Perimeter fence height and condition
candidateControls.objective: The perimeter fence is intact, of adequate height, and free of gaps or damage.

candidateControls.title: Perimeter clear zone
candidateControls.objective: A clear zone on both sides of the fence is free of objects that aid climbing or concealment.

condition.summary: Chain link fence with a vertical cut about 1 m long near a post; fabric pulled back.

deficiencies.description: Cut in fence fabric creates an opening large enough for a person to pass.

controls.rationale: Patrols may not have noticed the cut.

draftFindings.title: Cut in perimeter fence fabric
draftFindings.description: A vertical cut about 1 m long in the chain link fabric next to a line post leaves an opening.
draftFindings.recommendation: Repair the fabric and inspect the full fence line for other damage.
